title: Concept: MD5 use via Digest.string (ocaml) — review required
description: In ocaml, Digest.string computes MD5, whose collisions are cheap to construct, so integrity or identity checks built on it can be defeated. The remedy is a modern digest (a SHA-2 binding) for security purposes.
applicability: ocaml codebases hashing with Digest.string; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged digests where security is assumed; LOW severity.
